styles.era: 12-character serials (normalized), letter + digit + letter + 9 digits, year + month
styles.notes: Page (Style 3 detail): year = 4th & 5th digits, month = 6th & 7th digits (1-based, converted to 0-based half-open [3,5] and [5,7] on the normalized serial, dash stripped). COUNTING JUDGMENT CALL (coordinator review): digit-only counting is NOT falsified by Miller's own examples (it would give 2005-05 and 2010-01, both valid), so the choice rests on the page's own structure description: the serial 'ends with four numerical digits, followed by a dash and five numerical digits' — under character counting the four-digit block partitions cleanly as YYMM (9905 = 1999-05, 9510 = 1995-10), while digit-only counting would read the year out of the month half of that block. Character counting ships on that structural ground. The Style 1 list example G5R9510-01034 shares the identical shape and decodes consistently under the same stated positions, so it is carried as a second example; if Style 1 in fact had a distinct unstated rule, drop that example.
